dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Munkustrap's house caught fire and together with his thirty-cat tribe, he was brought to safety to the Manhattan Care Center. I wonder if Munkustrap was the protector and the brave leader of his group like in the musical CATS? He started as a very shy kitty at the care center, housed with a friend who was quickly adopted but he is slowly and surely evolving into a more confident feline. Munkustrap is curious of his visitor's presence, head bunts, leans into pets and I even got some purrs under my fingers(see his video). A home sweet home is what Munkustrap needs after his ordeal as well as an understanding new owner who will offer him love and a safe haven. Munkustrap is waiting for you at the Manhattan Care Center!
dog.name: Munkustrap
